questions.question: Krishna travels from point A to point B in 6 hours and returns back to point A from point B in 5 hours. Point A and point B are 220 miles apart along a straight highway. What is the average speed of Krishna for the whole journey?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time from point A to point B = 6 hour 

Time from point B to point A = 5 hour

**Concept used:**

Average speed = Total distance/total time

**Calculation:**

The total distance = 2 × 220 km

Average speed = 440/[6 + 5]

**Average speed = 40 miles/hr.**

questions.question: Find the ratio of the LCM of 44, 10 and 5 to the HCF of 50 and 75.
questions.solution:
Concept used:

LCM = LCM is the short form for “Least Common Multiple.” The least common multiple is defined as the smallest multiple that two or more numbers have in common.

HCF = It is the greatest factor present in between given two or more numbers.

**Calculation**

Using prime factorisation:

We, prime factorise each number in power format:

44 = 2² x 11

10 = 2 x 5

5 = 1 x 5

LCM = 2² x 5 x 11 = 220

Now the HCF of 50 and 75 will be:

50 = 2 x 5 x 5

75 = 3 x 5 x 5

HCF = 5²

The ratio of LCM and HCF = 220 : 25

T**he ratio of LCM and HCF = 44 : 5.**

questions.question: Vijay sells bananas at the rate of Rs. 13 per dozen and earns a profit of 30 percent. The cost price of the bananas increases by 10 percent. If the selling price remains the same, then what is his new profit percent?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the initial Cost Price (CP) be 100 units.

Since the initial profit is 30%, Selling Price (SP) = 130 units.

The new CP increases by 10%, so New CP = 110 units.

Since the SP remains the same (130 units), New Profit = 130 − 110 = 20 units.

New Profit % = (20 ÷ 110) × 100 = 18.18%.

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) of bananas = Rs. 13 per dozen

Initial Profit = 30%

Cost Price increases by 10% and SP remains the same.

**Formula Used:**

CP = (SP × 100) ÷ (100 + Profit%)

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91479e78d83e8245bc1f567ee460f7c4a22ad02a82c1e5c77aaa1f0aee9d7f00.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Initial CP = (13 × 100) ÷ (100 + 30)

⇒ Initial CP = 1300 ÷ 130 = Rs. 10

⇒ New CP = Initial CP + 10% of Initial CP

⇒ New CP = 10 + (10 ÷ 100) × 10 = Rs. 11

⇒ The Selling Price remains the same, so New SP = Rs. 13

⇒ New Profit = New SP − New CP = 13 − 11 = Rs. 2

⇒ New Profit % = (New Profit ÷ New CP) × 100

⇒ New Profit % = (2 ÷ 11) × 100 = 18.18%

**∴ The correct answer is 18.18%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) and Discount

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price. Selling Price (SP) = MP − Discount. Furthermore, Discount % = (Discount ÷ MP) × 100.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given on an article, Effective Single Discount = a + b − (a × b ÷ 100)%.

Dishonest Dealer Trick

If a dealer sells goods at CP but uses a false weight, his Profit % = [Error ÷ (True Value − Error)] × 100.
</p

questions.question: Height of a cone is 12 cm and radius of its base is 14 cm. What is the volume of the cone?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of cone = (1/3) × (22/7) × r² × h

Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 14 × 14 × 12

Volume = 22 × 2 × 14 × 4 = 2464 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2464 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius (r) = 14 cm

Height (h) = 12 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 

 
 
• 
 
• 
 h = 12 cm
 r = 14 cm
 Volume = (1/3) π r² h

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 14 × 14 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 22 × (14 ÷ 7) × 14 × 12

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × 22 × 2 × 14 × 12

⇒ Volume = 22 × 2 × 14 × (12 ÷ 3)

⇒ Volume = 22 × 2 × 14 × 4

⇒ Volume = 44 × 56

⇒ Volume = 2464 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 2464 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Slant Height of Cone

The distance from the apex to any point on the circular base edge, given by l = √(r² + h²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the lateral surface of the cone, calculated as CSA = π × r × l.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The sum of the curved surface area and the area of the circular base, TSA = π × r × (l + r).</p

questions.question: A dealer marks his goods at 44% above the cost price. Then he allows 50% discount on it. What would be his loss percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Mark-up rate = 44%

Discount = 50%

**Formula used:**

M.P = (100 + m)/100 × C.P

where, m = mark-up rate, M.P = marked price and C.P = cost price

S.P = (100 - d)/100 × M.P

where, d = discount, M.P = marked price and S.P = selling price

Loss% = (C.P - S.P)/C.P × 100

**Calculation**

Let the C.P. be 100.

M.P = (100 + 44)/100 × 100

M.P = 144/100 × 100

M.P = 144

Now, the S.P will be:

S.P = (100 - 50)/100 × 144

S.P = 50/100 × 144

S.P = 72

Loss% = (100 - 72)/100 × 100

**Loss% = 28**

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**

questions.question: The average of 15 numbers is 45. One more number is added, and the new average becomes 50. What is that new number?
questions.solution:
**Given**

The average of 15 numbers = 45

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of values/No. of values

**Calculation**

The sum of all 15 numbers = 15 × 45 = 675

The new sum of 16 numbers = 16 × 50 = 800

The new number = The new sum of 16 numbers - The sum of all 15 numbers

⇒ The new number = 800 - 675 = 125

**The new number is 125.**

questions.question: If two successive discounts of 10 percent and 20 percent are offered, then what is the net discount?
questions.solution:
**Given**

The two successive discounts are 10% and 20%.

**Formula used**

Net discount = D₁ + D₂ - (D₁ × D₂)/100

Where D₁ and D₂ are the successive discounts given.

**Calculation**

Net discount = 10 + 20 - (10 × 20)/100

Net discount = 30 - 2 = **28%**

questions.question:
Time taken by boat to cover a distance of x km in upstream is 3 hours more than the time taken by the boat to cover the same distance in downstream. Speed of the boat in upstream is 8 km/hr. Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

I. If the value of x is 48 km, then speed of boat in downstream is 16 km/hr.

II. If the speed of boat in downstream is 12 km/hr, then the value of x is 48 km.
questions.solution:
**Given**

Tᵤ - Td (difference between the time taken by boat upstream and downstream) = 3 hours.

The speed of the boat upstream = 8 km/hr

Distance = x km

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/speed

**Calculation**

Let the speed of the boat downstream be Sd.

⇒ x/8 - x/Sd = 3 --------- (i)

Now, from option I, if x = 48 km and the boat's downstream speed is 16 km/hr.

Putting the given values in eq(i).

⇒ 48/8 - 48/16 = 3

⇒ 3 = 3 (L.H.S. = R.H.S)

Now, from option II, if x = 48 km and the boat's downstream speed is 12 km/hr.

Putting the given values in eq(i).

⇒ 48/8 - 48/12 = 3

⇒ 2 ≠ 3

**Hence, the only option I follow.**

questions.question: There are 1200 men in a group. They have food for 80 days. After 5 days, 400 men left the group. Remaining food will last for how many days?
questions.solution:
**Given**

No. of men = 1200

No. of days for which food is available = 80 days

**Formula used:**

Total Food = Number of days (Time) (D) × Number of men (M). 

**Solution**

⇒ m₁ × d₁ = m₂ × d₂

⇒ Food consumption in 80 days - Food consumption in 5 days = Food consumption for remaining men

⇒ (1200 × 80) - (5 × 1200) = (1200 - 400) × d2

⇒ d₂ = 90000/800

**⇒ d2 = 112.5 days**
